byCheck.label: Grid places lost without a penalty

knownDifferences.title: Sprint date is one day earlier
knownDifferences.reason: The app dates a sprint on the day it was run. Jolpica's sprint data carries the Grand Prix date, one day later.

knownDifferences.title: Las Vegas date differs by one day
knownDifferences.reason: The app stores the Las Vegas Grand Prix under its local Saturday; Jolpica dates it Sunday in UTC.

knownDifferences.title: Missing qualifying times
knownDifferences.reason: The app is missing this qualifying time that Jolpica has. This is a known gap that has not been filled in yet.

knownDifferences.title: Missing qualifying times

knownDifferences.title: Provisional classification
knownDifferences.reason: After a race the app first shows OpenF1's provisional result, which lists a car OpenF1 leaves unclassified without a retirement flag as 'Not classified'. For up to three days the app looks at Jolpica again and replaces it with Jolpica's official classification, which says 'Retired', as soon as that exists.
